description: Wave D+E: Certification Gates and Runtime Chain - Add 9 gate methods to certification/gates.py (Contract, Dependency, and extend existing UBRC, Registry, Renderer, Brand, Theme, Composer, Evidence gates). Implement runtime agents 12K-12L (Runtime Agent, Playwright Browser Agent orchestrating Node via pnpm exec). All gates run in parallel after post-placement verification. Note: ILS, LSNB, RSSB gates deferred to Phase 2 per design review.
steps: Add execute_contract_gate() method to services/project-ai/app/certification/gates.py CertificationGateExecutor class. Verifies TutorialBlock interface compliance by checking snapshot for packages/types/src/tutorial-rich-document.ts interface evidence. Returns GateExecutionResult with status PASS if block implements required interface fields (id, type, content, metadata), evidence_ids from type definition. Per design doc gate specification

Add execute_dependency_gate() method to CertificationGateExecutor. Calls verification/dependency module (if exists) or implements dependency graph validation. Checks for circular dependencies, version conflicts, unlicensed packages from snapshot.dependencies. Returns GateExecutionResult with PASS if no violations, evidence_ids from dependency evidence

Update execute_ubrc_gate() method in CertificationGateExecutor to verify data-block-version attributes from snapshot evidence. Ensure all blocks have valid UBRC versions. Add evidence_ids binding. Return GateExecutionResult per standard pattern
Update execute_registry_verification_gate() to verify block registry entries from snapshot. Check all placed blocks registered correctly. Add evidence_ids binding
Update execute_renderer_verification_gate() to verify renderer compatibility from snapshot renderer evidence. Add evidence_ids binding

Update execute_brand_independence_gate() to consume snapshot.brand data (NO Path.read_text() file scanning). Verify neutral palette, no hardcoded brand markers. Add evidence_ids binding. Calls verification/brand.py

Update execute_theme_compatibility_gate() to consume snapshot.theme data (NO Path.read_text() file scanning). Verify CSS variables, theme overrides. Add evidence_ids binding. Calls verification/theme.py
Update execute_composer_verification_gate() to verify composer integration via verification/composer.py. Add evidence_ids binding
Update execute_evidence_binding_gate() to validate all evidence from prior gates bound correctly to commit_sha + snapshot_hash. Verify no orphaned evidence

Create services/project-ai/app/agents/runtime_agent.py with execute_runtime_agent(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult. Calls verification/runtime.py verify_runtime(). Sets up test environment, runs runtime verification, collects results. Returns AgentResult with outputs: runtime_status, test_results, evidence_ids

Create services/project-ai/app/agents/playwright_browser_agent.py with execute_playwright_browser_agent(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult. Orchestrates Node Playwright via subprocess: subprocess.run(['pnpm', 'exec', 'playwright', 'test', '--config=playwright.project-ai.config.ts'], env=test_env, cwd=repo_root, timeout=600). Sets environment: PROJECT_AI_BASE_URL, PROJECT_AI_RUN_ID, PROJECT_AI_COMMIT_SHA, PROJECT_AI_SNAPSHOT_HASH. Parses .project-ai/runs/current/results/playwright.json for test results. Returns AgentResult with outputs: browser_status, tests_passed, tests_failed, screenshot_paths, evidence_ids. NO Python Playwright library - orchestrate Node only per design doc Agent 12L spec

Update existing verification modules (brand.py, theme.py, composer.py, runtime.py, browser.py) to accept snapshot parameter and return evidence_ids in results. Ensure NO direct file scanning - consume snapshot data only

Create tests/certification/test_gates.py (if not exists) or extend existing with test cases for all 9 gate methods: test_contract_gate_pass, test_dependency_gate_pass, test_ubrc_gate_pass, test_registry_gate_pass, test_renderer_gate_pass, test_brand_gate_pass, test_theme_gate_pass, test_composer_gate_pass, test_evidence_binding_gate_pass. Mock snapshot data
Create tests/agents/test_runtime_agent.py with test cases: test_runtime_verification_success, test_runtime_failure, test_environment_setup, test_evidence_collection

Create tests/agents/test_playwright_browser_agent.py with test cases: test_playwright_execution_success, test_environment_variables_set, test_json_results_parsing, test_screenshot_collection, test_playwright_timeout, test_no_python_playwright. Mock subprocess.run for pnpm exec
Update services/project-ai/app/orchestration/agent_registry.py to register: RUNTIME_AGENT, PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER_AGENT. Update existing gate agent types as needed
acceptance_criteria: 9 gate methods added/updated in certification/gates.py: Contract, Dependency, UBRC, Registry, Renderer, Brand, Theme, Composer, Evidence. All return GateExecutionResult with evidence_ids

Dependency gate validates dependency graph from snapshot

Runtime Agent calls verification/runtime.py and collects evidence

Gate tests cover all 9 gates with pass/fail scenarios

Agent registry updated with runtime agents
verification: cd services/project-ai && python -c 'from app.certification.gates import CertificationGateExecutor; import inspect; methods = [m for m in dir(CertificationGateExecutor) if m.startswith("execute_") and "gate" in m]; print(f"Found {len(methods)} gate methods: {methods}"); assert len(methods) >= 9, f"Expected at least 9 gates, found {len(methods)}"'

cd services/project-ai && python -c 'from app.agents.runtime_agent import execute_runtime_agent; from app.agents.playwright_browser_agent import execute_playwright_browser_agent; print("Runtime agents import OK")'
